ambient_events: A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a flowerbed one at a time.
Somebody eats a hot dog on a bench and watches the Coliseum wall.
A pigeon lands on the nearest lamp and looks at you.
description: The West Gardens, round a bronze of Sir Charles B. Hughson on a granite plinth. He faces the Coliseum with one hand raised and his hat in the other. His shoes are rubbed gold at the toes.
name: West Gardens
